key_fields.name: 9998-PRIMING-QUERY
key_fields.meaning: Connectivity check: SELECT 1 INTO WS-DUMMY-DB2-INT FROM SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1; any SQLCODE other than 0 sets WS-DB2-ERROR, sets action 'Db2 access failure. ' and formats the message.

key_fields.name: 9998-PRIMING-QUERY-EXIT
key_fields.meaning: Exit paragraph for the PERFORM THRU range of the priming query.

key_fields.name: 9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE
key_fields.meaning: Calls DSNTIAC (via LIT-DSNTIAC) with DFHEIBLK, DFHCOMMAREA, SQLCA, WS-DSNTIAC-FORMATTED and WS-DSNTIAC-LRECL; on a non-zero DSNTIAC return code substitutes the WS-DSNTIAC-ERROR text; builds WS-LONG-MSG = trimmed WS-DB2-CURRENT-ACTION + ' SQLCODE:' + WS-DISP-SQLCODE + formatted text and moves it to WS-RETURN-MSG.

key_fields.name: 9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE-EXIT
key_fields.meaning: Exit paragraph for the PERFORM THRU range of the message formatter.

observations.text: Line 63 has a malformed sequence area (' 06400') and several lines (58, 60, 64-66) lack sequence numbers; harmless in columns 1-6 but indicates hand edits.
MOVE 'DSNTIAC CD: ' (12 characters) into WS-DSNTIAC-ERR-MSG (PIC X(10)) truncates to 'DSNTIAC CD'.
The procedures depend on data items not defined in CSDB2RWY: LIT-DSNTIAC, WS-LONG-MSG and WS-RETURN-MSG must be defined by the including program, and DFHEIBLK/DFHCOMMAREA make the copybook CICS-only.
9998-PRIMING-QUERY treats any non-zero SQLCODE, including positive warnings, as a DB2 error.

purpose: Common DB2 procedure-division paragraphs for CardDemo CICS/DB2 programs, used with the working storage in CSDB2RWY. 9998-PRIMING-QUERY checks DB2 connectivity with a dummy SELECT from SYSIBM.SYSDUMMY1, and 9999-FORMAT-DB2-MESSAGE turns the current SQLCA into a readable message (via IBM DSNTIAC) stored in WS-RETURN-MSG. It is included at the end of COTRTLIC's procedure division (EXEC SQL INCLUDE CSDB2RPY).
